# Marathon Training Nutrition Plan

## 1. DAILY CALORIE NEEDS

**BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate):** ~1,700 calories
**Activity Factor:** 1.7 (heavy training)
**Daily Requirement:** ~2,900 calories
**With marathon training peaks:** 3,100-3,500 calories on long run days

---

## 2. MACRONUTRIENT BREAKDOWN

| Macro | Amount | Calories | % of diet |
|-------|--------|----------|-----------|
| **Carbs** | 400-450g | 1,600-1,800 | 55-60% |
| **Protein** | 110-135g | 440-540 | 15-18% |
| **Fat** | 80-95g | 720-855 | 25-28% |

*Higher carbs support endurance; adequate protein aids recovery*

---

## 3. MEAL TIMING AROUND WORKOUTS

### **Morning (6-7 AM) - Before Long Runs**
- 2-3 hours prior: Oatmeal + banana + almond butter
- 30 min prior: Banana or energy gel

### **During Run (>90 min)**
- 6-8g carbs/minute
- Sports drink, gels, or chews

### **Post-Workout (within 30-60 min) - CRITICAL**
- Chocolate milk, smoothie, or rice + chicken
- 1.2g carbs/kg body weight (82g)
- 0.25g protein/kg body weight (17g)

### **Other Meals**
- Breakfast, lunch, dinner spread throughout day
- Snacks as needed

---

## 4. SAMPLE DAILY MEAL PLAN (3,200 cal)

| Meal | Food | Grams | Carbs | Protein | Fat |
|------|------|-------|-------|---------|-----|
| **Breakfast** | Oatmeal + banana + honey + egg | 100+100+20+50 | 80g | 15g | 5g |
| **Snack 1** | Greek yogurt + granola | 200+50 | 45g | 15g | 3g |
| **Lunch** | Brown rice + chicken + olive oil | 150+150+15 | 55g | 35g | 15g |
| **Snack 2** | Apple + peanut butter | 150+30 | 40g | 8g | 9g |
| **Dinner** | Pasta + ground turkey + tomato sauce | 150+150+100 | 60g | 35g | 8g |
| **Evening** | Chocolate milk | 300ml | 35g | 8g | 2g |
| **TOTALS** | | | **315g** | **116g** | **42g** |

---

## 5. BEST FOODS BY CATEGORY

**Complex Carbs:** Oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, pasta, sweet potatoes, quinoa
**Protein:** Chicken, turkey, lean beef, eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, fish
**Healthy Fats:** Olive oil, avocado, nuts, nut butters, fatty fish
**Recovery:** Chocolate milk, bananas, berries, honey

---

## 6. CARB-LOADING STRATEGY (Last 3 Days Before Race)

- Increase carbs to **500-600g/day** (70% of calories)
- Reduce fiber slightly to avoid GI issues
- Maintain protein and hydration
- Reduce long training volumes

---

## KEY TIPS
✅ Hydrate: 3-4 liters daily (more on run days)  
✅ Time carbs around workouts for maximum benefit  
✅ Eat every 3-4 hours  
✅ Test all race-day foods in training first  
✅ Budget-friendly: Rice, oats, eggs, canned tuna, frozen vegetables are cheap staples
